caption: The drawing features six rectangular swatches arranged in two rows of three columns, each showcasing a different pattern and color scheme on what appears to be fabric samples. The top left swatch has diagonal pink and white stripes with darker red flowers and branches overlaid. The top center swatch is solid black with red four-petaled flowers and small white centers evenly distributed. The top right swatch has a white background with an abstract and colorful pattern, including blue and yellow star-like shapes, red and blue curved lines, and additional thin black lines. The bottom left swatch is purple with a checkerboard pattern and features black-and-white floral clusters. The bottom center swatch has a very light background with a scattered motif of red and gray leaves along with small gray flowers. The bottom right swatch has a pink background with horizontal rows of red branches and leaves, repeated in a consistent pattern.
title: Materials from Quilt
